variant: Basic EDU / Smart EDU / Max EDU
name: DOBOT Rover X1 Explorer EDU
summary: A low-cost wheel-leg robot dog for teaching and robotics research with an SDK; the Max EDU adds a Livox Mid360 lidar for mapping and navigation.

germany.statusNote: Terra Robotics (Germany) lists Basic EDU EUR 3,999, Smart EDU EUR 4,999 and Max EDU EUR 6,999 (all net) with an order button; on 2026-10-02 only the Max EDU was orderable, Basic and Smart showed as not available.

priceEur.note: Basic EDU; Smart EDU EUR 4,999, Max EDU EUR 6,999 net.

sellers.name: Terra Robotics (Terra Connect GmbH)
sellers.note: German shop of Terra Connect GmbH (Löhne); prices shown excl. VAT; Max EDU EUR 6,999 is the only variant in stock.

specs.label: Net weight
specs.conditions: 15.5 kg with point feet, 18.5 kg with wheel feet

specs.label: Size standing (L x W x H)
specs.conditions: wheel legs; 761 x 372 x 428 mm with point legs

specs.label: Max. speed
specs.conditions: wheel legs; 1.8 m/s with point legs

specs.label: Runtime
specs.conditions: Basic EDU up to 3 h; Smart and Max EDU about 2.5 h; 8000 mAh battery

specs.label: Compute
specs.conditions: Smart EDU and Max EDU; Basic EDU has the standard platform

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: Front and rear cameras; Intel RealSense D435i (Smart, Max); Livox Mid360 lidar SLAM (Max only)

specs.label: SDK
specs.value: Unified SDK for secondary development, high- and low-level control
specs.conditions: same code across Basic, Smart and Max

specs.label: Wheel-foot kit
specs.value: Sold separately as an accessory (EUR 1,000 net)

notes: Wheel-leg operation needs the wheel-foot kit, which Terra sells as a separate accessory; the seller does not say whether it is included.
Payload 3 to 7 kg; 3 kg used here as the safe value.
Runtime about 2.5 h for Smart and Max EDU, up to 3 h for Basic EDU.
No IP rating stated; an education and research platform, not a site machine.
